d:
“New Riot” is about embracing chaos and rage as sources of power. It’s a declaration against being boxed in or underestimated. Through anger, I embrace the universe's chaos — I'm only a tiny reflection of cosmic chaos.
Audio Credits:
Performed by: Reble
Produced by: Parimal Shais
Written by: Daiaphi Lamare, Parimal E.K, Krishnanunni
Mixed & Mastered by: Akash Shravan
Label: Homegrown Music / Atlantic Records
